toolchain-doctor.description: Read-only Rocky environment and required-tool availability check.
arguments: set -e; echo '== OS =='; cat /etc/os-release; echo '== Tools =='; command -v python3; python3 --version; for tool in vcs dc_shell vivado; do if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s=' "$tool"; command -v "$tool"; else printf '%s=NOT_FOUND\n' "$tool"; fi; done

uvm-qam-ofdm-bittrue.description: Compile and run the MATLAB-quantized 10,240-sample QAM-OFDM UVM bit-true testcase.
